title: US Return-to-Office Mandates Survey, 2026
population: US employees whose employer introduced a new or stricter return-to-office policy in the past 12 months
weighting: Each respondent carries the vendor's stratification weight (field: weight). results/ shows unweighted counts and percentages plus weighted_pct.

not_published.reason: Open-ended text answers can contain identifying details.

questions.text: If you could send an anonymous message to your CEO about the true impact this policy has had on your life and loyalty, what would you say?
